results.proposal_summary: Expertise France (under the NUMÜ/WATANI programme) invites Tunisian organizations to apply for grants of €50,000–€200,000 to provide business acceleration, coaching, training, market access, and innovation support services to startups, SMEs, and other enterprises with at least 1 year of existence in Tunisia. The call is open on a rolling basis from 14 April 2026 until 30 September 2028 or until funds are exhausted. Lead applicants must be legal entities established in Tunisia for at least 3 years with experience in entrepreneurial support; foreign organizations may only participate as co-applicants. Mandatory co-financing of 10–60% of total project cost is required. Projects must be implemented in Tunisia, last a maximum of 24 months, and end by 30 September 2028. Applications are submitted via the POPS online platform.
results.ilo_match_evidence: While the call mentions employment creation indicators (jobs created in supported enterprises), its primary focus is private-sector SME acceleration and enterprise support services in Tunisia, which falls outside core ILO mandate areas of labour standards, social protection, social dialogue, and decent work policy.
